name: Bait and switch: the learned move
engine: Beat a defender with one move until he learns it, then beat him with another while he guesses.
about: The first attack is for show: no shot and no stamina, and afterwards their defence is stretched in every attack. Yamal and Baena beat a man with a move until he learns it; then that defender is guessing (-2 against any other move of theirs), the room he leaves is +3 instead of +1 (Bait), and a pass meant for the watched man goes to Olmo, arriving late and unmarked (Arrives late). Once a match, the wide forwards change their runs and what the defenders learned is gone.
decisions: Repeat the move that worked, knowing the defender will learn it: that learning is what the rest of the build spends.
Then switch: the other move, the room option, or the pass to Olmo arriving late.
Give up the first attack: no shot in it, for a stretched defence in every attack after.
